# Approach

This engagement with VONQ is focused on enabling a successful near-term exit by rapidly designing a scalable, investor-ready exit reporting suite. Our methodology is rooted in close stakeholder collaboration, proven data strategy frameworks, and actionable design deliverables. We will leverage existing data and reporting assets within the Qlik Warehouse while identifying key gaps, requirements, and best-practice approaches needed to deliver an M&A-ready reporting suite. The project will be delivered in clearly defined phases, ensuring alignment with VONQ’s exit timeline and business priorities.

Our approach is organized into a structured Discovery & Design phase, ensuring that all critical preparatory work—including requirements gathering, KPI framework definition, data feasibility, and conceptual modeling—is completed within a focused four-week window. The design outputs will be robust, decision-ready artefacts that set a clear blueprint for technical delivery in Phase 2. All activities will be scheduled to maximize input from VONQ’s finance, commercial, data/analytics, and leadership teams, as well as coordination with external advisors.

---

**Phase 1: Discovery & Design, Duration: 4 weeks, Timeline: Week 1 (29 June 2026) to Week 4 (24 July 2026)**
  
**Summary:**  
Produce a validated exit reporting suite design—including equity narratives, KPI framework, dashboard mock-ups, data model, tooling recommendations, and implementation roadmap—to underpin the M&A process and guide subsequent build activities.

**Activities:**  
- Host structured stakeholder workshops to define equity narratives, identify reporting requirements, and confirm critical KPIs for exit/investor readiness  
- Conduct a data feasibility assessment across Finance System, CRM, ERP, legacy data, and Qlik Warehouse, including playback of data gap findings  
- Design a prioritised ‘Metrics that Matter’ KPI framework, establishing calculation definitions and aligning to equity narratives  
- Develop static dashboard mock-ups specifying layout, navigation, and reporting scope for investor and leadership consumption  
- Create a conceptual data model and draft data pipeline automation approaches (batch processing), identifying any integration challenges  
- Prepare a tooling and infrastructure options paper (with pros/cons), plus a phased implementation roadmap outlining dependencies, risks, and next steps for Phase 2

---

The structured phased approach ensures VONQ receives actionable and investor-ready reporting design deliverables on an accelerated timeline, minimizing transaction risk and positioning the company for a successful exit. By focusing Phase 1 exclusively on design, requirements definition, and feasibility, the foundation is laid for a seamless transition to subsequent technical build work (Phase 2) and lasting post-transaction scalability.
